source: Supernote Manta (A5X2), adb device SN100D20051174, system apps under /system_ext/app, pulled with adb pull, read with aapt2 dump badging and aapt2 dump xmltree, 2026-11-25 (#271)

vector.from: launcher icons that are vector drawables: Settings (com.ratta.settings res/sn1.xml), To-Do (supernote.task res/lO.xml), Calendar (supernote.calendar res/-I.xml), Email (supernote.email res/qT.xml), Digest (supernote.knowledge res/Rs.xml)
vector.inkMarginNote: the stroke outline (centerline +- 2) of Settings, Digest and Email reaches 2 from the edge of the 48 box; this is the launcher icons' margin

bitmap.from: launcher icons that are bitmaps: Note (supernote.note res/vD.png) and Document (supernote.document res/A_.png), 64 x 64 grey with alpha, measured on the pixels

exception: InkHub (res/vx.xml) is a filled black vector; it is the one native icon that is not an outline and is not followed

toolbar.from: the Note app's (com.ratta.supernote.note) 64 x 64 toolbar and lasso icons, 71 that draw on white, read on their pixels (dark below 50%), 2026-11-25 (#271)
toolbar.inkMarginNote: the median smallest gap between the ink and the box, over the four sides; the selected states, which fill their whole box, are left out
toolbar.strokeNote: re-measured 2026-11-25 (#271, third pass): across each straight run of ink in a row or column, the sum of its pixel darkness is the stroke width, anti-aliasing included; 32 of the 41 single-stroke icons give 4 px

plugin.note: Plugin icons are 96 x 96 PNGs; the tablet scales a lasso row to 60 px (docs/supernote.md). Each plugin icon is a Tabler glyph on its 24 grid written with `padding` units around it (viewBox -5 -5 34 34): the stroke, 2.125 of 34, is the toolbar icons' 4 of 64, and a glyph, whose centrelines Tabler keeps within 2 to 22, keeps its stroke outline at least 5.94 of 34 (17.5%) from the edge, above the toolbar icons' 11 of 64 (17.2%); its ink spans 65% of the box, as theirs does (42 of 64).
